p: downsitting and mine uprising: He confesses that neither our actions, thoughts or any part of our life can be hid from God, though he seems to be far off.
compassest my path and my lying: So that they are evidently known to you.
tongue: You know my meaning before I speak.
hand upon me: You so guide me with your hand, that I can turn no way, but where you appoint me.
spirit: From your power and knowledge?
lead me: Your power holds me so fast that there is no way I can escape from you.
light about me: Though darkness is a hinderance to man's sight, yet is serves your eyes as well as the light.
possessed my reins: You have made me in all parts and therefore must know me.
fearfully and wonderfully made: Considering your wonderful work in forming me, I cannot but praise you and fear your mighty power.
in the lowest parts of the: That is, in my mother's womb: which he compares to the inward parts of the earth.
and in thy book all my: Seeing that you knew me before I was composed of either flesh or bone, much more now must you know me when you have fashioned me.
precious also are thy thoughts unto: How should we esteem the excellent declaration of your wisdom in the creation of man?
I am still with thee: I continually see new opportunity to meditate in your wisdom, and to praise you.
hate them: He teaches us boldly to contemn all the hatred of the wicked and friendship of the world, when they would prevent us from serving God sincerely.
wicked way in me: Or any heinous or rebellious way: meaning that though he was subject to sin, yet he was not given to wickedness, and to provoke God by rebellion.
way everlasting: That is, continue your favour toward me to the end.
